name: Bibou ~Vintage~ REAL
original_name: 美貌 ~ヴィンテージ~ REAL
source:
A remake version of [url=/v6931]Bibou ~Vintage~[/url]
The differences include:
- totally different scripts
- a short opening
- multiple endings
- a new side-story made by the Ecchi V Cinema master [url=/s14993]Okano Yuuki[/url] that explodes in the crotch
- animated scenes by a lead animator.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]

[url=/v6931]Bibou ~Vintage~[/url] 的翻拍版
